purpose: Fail closed when a new dynamic HTML sink appears without an explicit source and encoding review.

reviewed_inner_html_files.src/pages/admin/editorial/index.astro: Protected operator UI; action markup is constructed from fixed labels and encoded identifiers.
reviewed_inner_html_files.src/pages/cost-calculator.astro: Local calculator state; labels and source metadata are encoded before interpolation. Retain focused adversarial tests.
reviewed_inner_html_files.src/pages/search.astro: Repository-built search index and user query; displayed fields are escaped before interpolation.
reviewed_inner_html_files.src/pages/camps/index.astro: Three innerHTML sinks in the client filter script, added 2026-07-31 when card rendering moved to src/lib/camp-card.ts (Pillar 14 open item #74). (1) mapEl.innerHTML = '' in initMap() only ever assigns a literal empty string to clear the static no-JS fallback markup before Leaflet mounts; no interpolation, nothing to escape. (2) pnwGrid.innerHTML and (3) nationalGrid.innerHTML in renderGrids() are both set from renderCardHtml(c, sportsList).join(''), the same shared renderer camp-card.ts exports for SSR. Every camp-derived field renderCardHtml touches (id, slug, name, city, state, sport, hero_photo_key, price_text, date_added, and the verification/freshness label) is passed through camp-card.ts's escHtml() at its interpolation site, confirmed by reading renderCardHtml/renderFeaturedCardHtml/photoHtml/verifiedHtml/priceHtml/addedLineHtml directly rather than assuming; sportsList itself is CAMP_SPORTS from src/data/site.ts, served back through GET /api/camps/lite, and is also escaped at the call site regardless. The Leaflet popup in the same script (marker.bindPopup) is a separate sink already using escHtml on every interpolated field (found unescaped and fixed in QA 2026-07-31); it is not matched by this contract because it does not use innerHTML.

reviewed_html_string_files.src/pages/camps/index.astro: Server-built directory cards; database-derived values and attributes pass through escHtml before set:html.

json_script_rule: JSON script payloads must use JSON.stringify and must never be executable script content.
agent_content_rule: Agent-authored, imported, customer-derived, or database-derived values are untrusted even behind Access. Prefer Astro text interpolation; otherwise use a reviewed contextual encoder.
